description:
change(site, t0, t1) — the STRUCTURED CHANGE between two dated frames of one site (entity_type + id, or lat + lng): per class
    (water · ice · canopy · pad · stockpile · unknown) the area in m² by sensor, the area where the sensors agree, `sensors_agreed`
    and a `confidence` (high = Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar both flag it and agree on at least half of the smaller
    detection; medium = one sensor only; low = both flag it in different places, or stockpile from optics alone). Not a video and not a
    picture — fetch stills with look_at / look_through. Each sensor carries its own frame dates; for spans of 300+ days the t0 frame is
    taken at t1's day of year (same_season=true, default) so a season is not reported as change. A sensor that cannot see the pair says
    UNTESTABLE with its reason (cloud, alignment, no frame within 10 days, no common radar orbit); the answer is UNTESTABLE only when BOTH
    are. Footprint: the site's held footprint, else a 500 m circle (stated in `footprint`); radius_m 50..2500 overrides. Dates
    YYYY-MM-DD, t0 on/after 2015-06-23, t1 default today. Slow: about 30–60 s.
    AGENT KEYS ONLY (a browser session is refused BEFORE any charge). SIDE EFFECTS: none beyond the charge — read-only.
    ⚠ CHARGING: ONE quote, ONE debit = two stills at look_at's live price, reserved up front; an UNTESTABLE answer costs nothing.
    Quote with `billing_quote("/api/v1/entity.change")`; the JSON carries `charged_joules` and a `price` block.
name: entity_change
